divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: store-wide scans for MAC and MAE terms near termination and dispute words (each timing out at first and rerun in the background, by prefix or in chunks), then reads of the lead matter's termination notice, deficiency notice, board memo and demand-letter analysis plus termination memos of a few other matters, and an answer naming the lead matter with near candidates excluded. The runs differ in effort, not in route: T1 declared many agent-defined stages at reviewers' suggestion and, after writing, audited higher-numbered matters for recency in four extra stages without changing the answer; all of these fit existing stages. Label notes were ignored where they applied.
